name: Busa Radar
description: Market-intelligence desk: competitor signals, research briefs/reports, trend movers/opportunities, and a triage review queue

agentPrompts.label: Give me the intel desk overview
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-radar` skill in this folder, then give me the command-desk overview: signals to triage, briefs awaiting approval, reports ready to read, follow-ups running, watchlist freshness, and top trend movers.

agentPrompts.label: Run a monitoring pass now
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-radar` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then run a monitoring pass over the due watchlist sources, file any changes as normalized signals via `ingest_signals.mjs`, and give me the AirApp URL to triage them.

agentPrompts.label: Carry out my approved decisions
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-radar` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then run `execute_decisions.mjs` (dry-run) to list the concrete handoffs for my approved signals/briefs/opportunities, and after I confirm, perform them and run `execute_decisions.mjs --apply` to mark them done.
